verdict.rationale: Ollama's own docs list an official Python library and a JavaScript/TypeScript library for using Ollama from applications (ollama-docs-10, ollama-docs-11, ollama-docs-19). These sit on a documented REST API (ollama-gh-4), and OpenAI-compatible endpoints let existing client SDKs connect (ollama-docs-12). The evidence consists only of short headline mentions, with no detail on SDK depth. missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation (API coverage, versioning, typed interfaces), SDKs beyond Python/JS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
